descriptions.w3d_d24e_remap_properties_801ea59c: Walks the type list (0x8020ff3c); for types of kind 2 visits each object (0x8020fe00, 0x8020fe18) and each property (0x801e9db8). When bit 0 of the property's flag byte is set, a field at its offset equal to from[j] is replaced by to[j], stopping at the first hit. Returns the number of fields changed.
